study_identification_part.si_4_title: Dissimilarity in Sulcal Width Patterns in the Cortex can be Used to Identify Patients With Schizophrenia With Extreme Deficits in Cognitive Performance

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Generalized Additive Mixed Models (GAMMs) were used to model longitudinal trajectories and residualize for covariates (Age, Scanner, TBV). The Person-Based Similarity Index (PBSI) was used to quantify morphometric similarity, and Z-scores of the residualized PBSI were used to identify deviating individuals.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: To investigate the longitudinal trajectories of PBSI-SW over the age range, generalized additive mixed models (GAMMs) were used. ... PBSI-SW values were residualized for age, scanner, and total brain volume ... individual deviance of a participant's residualized PBSI-SW value ... with respect to the normative (ie, control) group was calculated
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Janssen2021.pdf.md: Statistical Analyses / Longitudinal Trajectory of PBSI-SW; Normative Modeling

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Person-Based Similarity Index for Sulcal Width (PBSI-SW). PBSI for Cortical Thickness (PBSI-CT) was also calculated for comparison.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: We calculated the PBSI for sulcal width (PBSI-SW) ... The PBSI-SW calculation was based on 16. ... We extended the PBSI such that it indexes the morphometric similarity ...

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age, Scanner, and Total Brain Volume (TBV) were used as fixed effects. 'Random effect of the individual' was included in the GAMM.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: GAMM models were implemented to examine age, diagnosis ... while controlling for scanner, total brain volume, and the random effect of the individual. ... PBSI-SW values were residualized for age, scanner, and total brain volume
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Janssen2021.pdf.md: Statistical Analyses / Longitudinal Trajectory of PBSI-SW; Cross-Sectional Comparisons
